subject: world_language
concept: Understanding and using the subjunctive or equivalent mood structures where the target language has them, for expressing wishes and hypotheticals
source_inspiration: adapted from CEFR B1-B2 'express hypothetical situations' can-do descriptor — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student practices simple wish/hypothetical statements aloud with the persona in the target language
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a hypothetical statement to the correct mood/structure in the target language
exercise.abstract: Student writes a sentence expressing a wish or hypothetical situation in the target language

misconception_flags: uses the indicative/factual mood structure where a hypothetical structure is required

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
target_language: configurable — student/parent selects target language at enrollment
